meta.test_window: prediction dates 2011-08-01 and 2011-09-01 (90-day outcome windows complete)
meta.intended_use: rank currently active, identified customers by 90-day churn risk to support human-reviewed retention planning
not_for: automated decisions about individuals (credit terms, exclusions)
customers inactive for more than 180 days

C_confident_false_positive.label: Case C: most confident false alarm

E_borderline.label: Case E: borderline, nearest the threshold

case_rule:
Documented selection rule (deterministic): A typical flagged churner (TP nearest median p of TPs); B typical retained (TN nearest median p of TNs);
C most confident false positive; D least confident false negative; E nearest to the decision threshold.

counterfactuals.immutable: tenure, product breadth, gap statistics, cancellations, country/group are held fixed

segment_audit.label: customer-segment audit: BEHAVIOURAL segments, not demographic and not protected characteristics
segment_audit.status: exploratory descriptive audit on the recorded test predictions; no retraining, no threshold change

fairness.grouping: UK vs non-UK customers (operational grouping, NOT a protected attribute)

M1_threshold_optimizer_equalized_odds.note: fitted on validation; validation numbers are in-sample for the optimizer
